t: Car cover with double-stitched seam for extra strength. Water-resistant material up to 1000mm hydrostatic pressure head test. Ideal for long term protection from the elements. Breathable material allows moisture to evaporate whilst still protecting the car. Elasticated hem allows for a tailored fit. Handy storage bag when not in use. Supplied with 2 adjustable straps with buckles for a secure windproof fit.
